# pve_user (Resource)

API user with realm, groups, TFA settings, and account expiry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_user" "example" {
  userid = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `userid` (String) Full User ID, in the `name@realm` format.

### Optional

- `append` (Boolean) <boolean>
- `comment` (String) <string>
- `email` (String) <string>
- `enable` (Boolean) Enable the account (default). You can set this to '0' to disable the account (default: 1)
- `expire` (Number) Account expiration date (seconds since epoch). '0' means no expiration date.
- `firstname` (String) <string>
- `groups` (String) <string>
- `keys` (String) Keys for two factor auth (yubico).
- `lastname` (String) <string>
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Initial password.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: userid (also the `terraform import` format).
- `tokens` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tokens))
